brandSources.note: Deliberate non-brand palette: an event has no brand. Very dark warm brown evokes soot and night, warm off-white text evokes lamplight and paper, and the fire-orange accent is the hot centre of the map. No company or organisation palette was copied.
Seven hues spread around the wheel (sand, orange, yellow, teal, rose-red, violet, green) so every cluster is distinct at small dot size; all checked >= 3:1 against the background by the build.
No webfont: Georgia/Palatino serif suggests a printed chronicle and renders offline.
